description:
She has access to Trump’s social media, a desk near the Oval Office, and a seat on Marine One. Foreign leaders reportedly text her when they can’t reach Trump directly. So who is Natalie Harp—and how did she become one of the president’s most trusted aides?

We trace her remarkable story from a life-threatening health crisis to Trump’s inner circle, and examine the loyalty, controversy, and extraordinary relationship that put her at the center of presidential power.
